svg.title: Scenario 5: Enemy Turn — Goblin Is Stunned, Skips Turn

g.text: Scenario 5: Enemy Turn — Goblin Is Stunned, Skips Turn
This is the enemy phase of the same executePlayerTurn() call as Scenario 4.
Warrior (SPD=30) already used Shield Bash — StunEffect on Goblin (remainingTurns=2).
Now: Goblin (SPD=25) tries to act but cannot.
Same user action that triggered Scenario 4.
Shown here for continuity — enemy phase
occurs in the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior phase: Shield Bash ran, StunEffect applied to Goblin.
Enemy AI strategy is NOT executed.
No attack TurnFrame is added for Goblin.
GameState.newTurnOrder() — Goblin still alive with StunEffect (turns=1)
note: no Goblin attack frame — Goblin was stunned
(Goblin did not attack — Stun icon remains)
